about.label: About Me
about.title: Building bots that work while you sleep
about.description: I'm a 19-year-old developer specializing in Telegram bot development. I create robust, production-ready bots — from complex task-management systems to real-estate search engines and automated group scanners. Beyond bots, I handle full server integration, deployment with Docker, monitoring with Grafana & Prometheus, and ongoing maintenance. I'm also a cybersecurity red team enthusiast, which means I build with security in mind from day one.

items.title: Custom Telegram Bots
items.description: End-to-end development of Telegram bots with complex business logic — task systems, databases, admin panels, user management, and inline keyboards.

items.title: Server Integration & Deployment
items.description: Full deployment pipeline — Docker containers, server configuration, CI/CD setup. Your bot runs 24/7 on the client's infrastructure.

items.title: Bot Monitoring & Support
items.description: Grafana dashboards, Prometheus metrics, alerting systems. I don't just deliver — I make sure your bot stays alive and performs.

items.title: Database Architecture
items.description: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis — designing efficient data models for high-load bots handling thousands of users and transactions.

items.title: Userbot & Automation
items.description: Userbot integrations for group scanning, keyword monitoring, and automated interactions — built with stealth and reliability in mind.

items.title: API Integrations
items.description: Connecting Telegram bots with external APIs — payment gateways, CRM systems, AI services, geocoding, and any third-party service.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's Build Something
contact.description: Need a Telegram bot? Have an automation idea? Let's talk. I handle everything from development to deployment and ongoing support.
